passages.text: Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven final plagues, with which the wrath of God is completed.
passages.sermon:
I saw a sign in heaven.
This sign was great.
This sign was marvelous.
I saw seven angels.
Each angel had a plague.
There were seven plagues in total.
These plagues were the last ones.
With these plagues, God’s wrath was finished.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἄλλο σημεῖον ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ μέγα καὶ θαυμαστόν ἀγγέλους ἑπτὰ ἔχοντας πληγὰς ἑπτὰ τὰς ἐσχάτας ὅτι ἐν αὐταῖς ἐτελέσθη ὁ θυμὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, beside which stood those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name. They were holding harps from God, and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
passages.sermon:
John saw a vision in heaven.
He saw something like a sea of glass.
The sea looked as if it was mixed with fire.
People stood beside this sea.
These people had conquered the beast.
They had also conquered the image of the beast.
They had conquered the number of the beast’s name.
They stood on the sea of glass.
They held harps from God.
They sang a song.
They sang the song of Moses, who is God’s servant.
They also sang the song of the Lamb.
They said, “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty!”
They said, “Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!”
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ὡς θάλασσαν ὑαλίνην μεμιγμένην πυρί καὶ τοὺς νικῶντας ἐκ τοῦ θηρίου καὶ ἐκ τῆς εἰκόνος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν τὴν ὑαλίνην ἔχοντας κιθάρας τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ᾄδουσιν τὴν ᾠδὴν Μωϋσέως τοῦ δούλου τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τὴν ᾠδὴν τοῦ Ἀρνίου λέγοντες Μεγάλα καὶ θαυμαστὰ τὰ ἔργα σου Κύριε ὁ Θεός ὁ Παντοκράτωρ δίκαιαι καὶ ἀληθιναὶ αἱ ὁδοί σου ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν ἐθνῶν

passages.text: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord is holy.
Only the Lord is holy.
The Lord deserves fear and glory.
Everyone should fear the Lord.
Everyone should glorify the Lord’s name.
All nations will come to the Lord.
All nations will worship before the Lord.
The Lord’s righteous acts have been revealed.
passages.original: τίς οὐ μὴ φοβηθῇ Κύριε καὶ δοξάσει τὸ ὄνομά σου ὅτι μόνος ὅσιος ὅτι πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιόν σου ὅτι τὰ δικαιώματά σου ἐφανερώθησαν

passages.text: After this I looked, and the temple—the tabernacle of the Testimony—was opened in heaven.
passages.sermon:
John saw a vision in heaven.
John looked after these things.
John saw the temple in heaven.
This temple is the tabernacle of the Testimony.
The temple was opened.
passages.original: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον καὶ ἠνοίγη ὁ ναὸς τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ

passages.text: And out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues, dressed in clean and bright linen and girded with golden sashes around their chests.
passages.sermon:
Seven angels came out of the temple in heaven.
Each angel carried one of the seven plagues.
The angels wore clean and bright linen.
They had golden sashes around their chests.
passages.original: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ ἑπτὰ ἄγγελοι οἱ ἔχοντες τὰς ἑπτὰ πληγὰς ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ ἐνδεδυμένοι λίνον καθαρὸν λαμπρὸν καὶ περιεζωσμένοι περὶ τὰ στήθη ζώνας χρυσᾶς

passages.text: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
One of the four living creatures stood in the temple in heaven.
This living creature gave seven golden bowls to the seven angels.
Each bowl was full of the wrath of God.
God lives forever and ever.
passages.original: Καὶ ἓν ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων ἔδωκεν τοῖς ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλοις ἑπτὰ φιάλας χρυσᾶς γεμούσας τοῦ θυμοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ζῶντος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων

passages.text: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power; and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
passages.sermon:
God is glorious and powerful.
God filled the temple with smoke from His glory and power.
No one could enter the temple.
This lasted until the seven angels finished the seven plagues.
passages.original: καὶ ἐγεμίσθη ὁ ναὸς καπνοῦ ἐκ τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐκ τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὸν ναὸν ἄχρι τελεσθῶσιν αἱ ἑπτὰ πληγαὶ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων
